summary: Regression check of the /api/salary HTTP 500 fix (math.inf on the top tier) and of /rider-dashboard. Backend: 13 of 13 read-only pytest tests passed. /api/salary returns 200 for 1-day, 1-month and 2-year ranges. The response parses as strict JSON, which rejects Infinity and NaN, and contains riders (list), tiers (5 entries) and rider_count, with rider_count equal to len(riders). The last tier, Immortal, has the integer threshold 999999999999, and the thresholds are in ascending order. The endpoint returns 401/403 without auth, 422 when params are missing, and rider_count 0 for an unknown rider_id. The other endpoints the dashboard loads all return 200: /dashboard/summary, /rider-stock/history, /sales, /deposits and /users?role=rider. Backend logs contain no new 'Out of range float' traceback after the patch reload; the old tracebacks are from before the patch. Frontend: the two-step Owner login (baa / 130994) works. /rider-dashboard renders fully: profile card, period filter, allowance, incentive, cups, tier card, charts, photo evidence, history, PDF and print. There is no 500 and no blank screen. Every /salary call returned 200. The only console errors are the expected pre-login 401s on /api/auth/me. There is no horizontal overflow on desktop (scrollWidth 1920 at 1920) or mobile (scrollWidth 390 at 390, no elements past the viewport). Limitation: the DB has no rider accounts (rider_count=0), so the per-rider branch of /salary (next_tier, progress) and /rider-rank were only reviewed in code, not run against real data. No data was created.

minor.issue: The next_tier logic is shifted by one tier. TIERS thresholds are each rank's upper bound, so a rider with gross < 1.75M gets next_tier 'Herald', which is their current rank, instead of 'Warriors'. A rider with gross >= 4M (Immortal) gets next_tier 'Immortal' with threshold 999999999999, remaining about 1e12 and progress about 0%. The UI would show 'Kategori berikutnya: Immortal · Rp 999.999.999.999'. For the top tier, next_tier should be None.

Two different rank systems are in use. tier_for() returns Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze (20/15/10/5%, needs 25 attendance days) and drives the incentive amount. TIERS and /rider-rank use Herald/Warriors/Masters/Divine/Immortal (0/5/7/10/15%). Salary incentive and rider-rank commission will disagree for the same rider.
Backend log on every reload: 'Storage init failed: 401 Unauthorized ... objstore/api/v1/storage/init'. Photo uploads that use object storage may fail.

integration_issues.issue: None of the 6 API calls in load() has a .catch. If /salary or /dashboard/summary fails, sal or sum stays null and the whole dashboard body stays hidden, with no error message or toast. This blank-screen behaviour could hide a future 500.

issues: The tier card shows '(× 1 RIDERS)' when there are 0 riders (agg.count falls back to 1).
The tier progress bar renders at 100% (full orange) when next_tier is undefined, which reads as 'target reached' with Rp 0 sales.
The period filter date inputs use the browser's native date picker rather than the shadcn calendar.
/api/salary is requested 6 times on one page load (StrictMode, DateFilter onChange and reload). Consider debouncing or guarding these fetches.

action_items: Fix next_tier in /api/salary: pick the next rank above the current one, and return None at the top tier (Immortal) so the 999999999999 sentinel never reaches the UI.
Unify tier_for() (Platinum/Gold/...) with TIERS/RIDER_RANKS (Herald..Immortal) so incentive % matches the rank shown.
Add .catch with toast and error state in the RiderDashboard load() calls.
Optional: when there are 0 riders, show an empty state in the tier card instead of '× 1' and a full progress bar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py TIERS uses 999999999999 as a sentinel in the public 'tiers' response. Prefer threshold null for the last tier and handle it on the client.
RiderDashboard.jsx has no loading or error states, and the effects fire duplicate fetches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: There are no rider users in the DB, so the per-rider /salary and /rider-rank paths have not been tested with data. Once a Rider exists, verify next_tier for gross < 1.75M and for gross >= 4M. UI login: set localStorage si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, fill login-identifier-input, click login-continue-button, fill pin-digit-0 with the 6-digit PIN, click pin-continue-button. rider-dash-select is a native <select>.
rca of the issue: The original 500 came from math.inf in TIERS: Starlette's json.dumps(allow_nan=False) raised 'Out of range float values are not JSON compliant'. The patch replaces it with the integer 999999999999 and fixes serialization. Remaining risk: that sentinel is exposed as Immortal's next_tier.
